Старт
UTF-8, лог, QuickEdit • глобалы • Add-Type TlsScanner

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ENGINE
Load-Config + DnsCache • заглушка UI → Get-Targets → Draw-UI
Get-NetworkInfo → Targets+Draw-UI • при устаревшем кэше повтор сети
RunCount%10=0 → Check-Update → подсказка U

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Get-NetworkInfo
DNS WMI • CDN redirector+прокси • GEO кэш 24ч или цепочка API • IPv6 если не только-IPv4

viewport body only • delta SetBufferContents

Меню
H Help • S Settings • P Proxy (смена GEO→сеть+targets)
D DNS DoH • G PATH ICMP • E EXTRA view
R Report • U Update GitHub

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Enter — скан
ScanPhase≠Idle→ignore • Internet check • NetCache
Ensure-TlsScanner • Start-ScanWithAnimation
LastScan • Start-DeferredPostScanExtras async

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Скан Ensure-ScanRunspacePool + $Worker
фаза1 WaitAny collect • Q/Esc abort+Stop workers • scroll OK
фаза2 reveal только visible rows • shared pool не Dispose

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Воркер DNS/PROXIED→HTTP80→ERR=IP BLOCK
TLS1.3+retry • TLS1.2+retry • AVAILABLE/THROTTLED/DPI RESET/DPI BLOCK/IP BLOCK

DNS/QUIC/TCP16/IpVsSni в runspace
merge ExtraDiag → recommendations • скролл не блокируется
